notes: t0/t1 are frame-accurate (first frame of shot / first frame of next shot). layer=overlay entries are superimposed face CUs that overlap base shots (dissolve in/out); generate them as separate clips and composite. Characters: BLACK = Swordsman in black, BLUE = Swordsman in blue, WOMAN = dead woman on the bier.

shots.shot_size: CU (insert, blade tip) in WS landscape
shots.lens_feel: normal-wide, deep focus (pavilion and far shore sharp)
shots.subjects_and_blocking: split-level waterline frame: lens half-submerged, upper ~40% above water, lower ~60% turquoise underwater. Wooden roofed pavilion on stilts in the water at left third, pine/autumn shore behind. A dark straight sword hangs vertically, point down, just right of center; no person visible (blade enters from top of frame).
shots.action: Blade descends slowly; its tip touches the mirror surface at ~0.4 s and breaks it; a few droplets spring up.
shots.cut_in: none (scene opens on it; source clip starts here)
shots.lighting_color: overcast, cold; teal water, muted mauve-grey shore
shots.dramatic_function: Motif statement: the sword touching the lake; calm before the duel.

shots.lens_feel: tele, very shallow DOF; shore a soft blur band
shots.subjects_and_blocking: split-level waterline frame: lens half-submerged, upper ~40% above water, lower ~60% turquoise underwater. Same blade, centered, framed tighter with no pavilion; out-of-focus shoreline in the top strip.
shots.action: Blade continues down; the point pierces the surface and the lower blade is seen underwater below the line.
shots.cut_in: hard cut, axial cut-in (same action, tighter lens)
shots.dramatic_function: Repeat the touch from a closer angle (two-angle rhyme).

shots.subjects_and_blocking: split-level waterline frame: lens half-submerged, upper ~40% above water, lower ~60% turquoise underwater. Back to the wide angle of shot 0: pavilion left, blade right of center.
shots.action: Blade lifts out of the water; a thin column of water drops is pulled up after the tip and hangs in the air; small rings spread.
shots.cut_in: hard cut back to wide (cut on action)
shots.dramatic_function: Completion of the touch; water obeys the sword.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: split-level waterline frame: lens half-submerged, upper ~40% above water, lower ~60% turquoise underwater. Tele framing, no pavilion. Blade tip just below the surface at center-left.
shots.action: Tip rises out; a trail of droplets rises and a thin line of disturbed water runs horizontally along the surface; drops fall back.
shots.dramatic_function: Ends the prologue on suspended water; a breath before the first clash.

shots.camera_move: handheld, fast tracking/whip right with the attacker
shots.lens_feel: normal, moderate DOF, heavy motion blur
shots.subjects_and_blocking: Grassy autumn hillside above the lake. BLUE at left foreground, BLACK at right edge; BLUE faces right.
shots.action: BLUE swings his sword high-to-low at BLACK; camera whips right with the stroke and ends on BLUE's face in CU as he rushes right.
shots.cut_in: hard cut (rhythm break from slow water to real-speed fight)
shots.lighting_color: flat overcast; desaturated grey-green with rust autumn scrub
shots.dramatic_function: First physical clash; establishes the 'hillside duel' plane.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLACK alone against mountain slope/sky, sword in right hand.
shots.action: BLACK spins a full turn (back to camera mid-spin), then ends square to camera extending his sword arm to frame left, robe and hair flying.
shots.cut_in: cut on action (BLUE's lunge -> BLACK's counter-spin)

shots.angle: low + dutch (~10° tilt), at water level
shots.subjects_and_blocking: split-level waterline frame: lens half-submerged, upper ~40% above water, lower ~60% turquoise underwater, tilted. Blue sky, autumn mountain at top. A sword blade enters the water from upper left; a dark-trousered leg/boot sweeps across the top of frame.
shots.action: The blade drags through the water toward/along the lens, throwing up a rolling wake of white spray that fills the frame.
shots.lighting_color: brighter: sky blue + teal water, white spray
shots.dramatic_function: Fight spills onto the lake; energy spike.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: split-level waterline frame: lens half-submerged, upper ~40% above water, lower ~60% turquoise underwater, tilted. Pavilion small in right background; dark blade vertical in right foreground.
shots.action: Blade slices right-to-left through the water; a glittering sheet of spray sweeps across the whole frame.
shots.dramatic_function: Second wake shot; carries the fight across the lake toward the pavilion.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Mirror-still lake: pavilion (roofed platform on stilts) upper-left, its reflection under it; the water reflects an inverted autumn mountain and pale sky. Bare frosted tree lower-left corner.
shots.action: Two tiny figures (one light blue, one dark) flit across the water past the pavilion, left to right, touching the surface. From ~9.3 s a face starts to show through (see overlay shot).
shots.vfx: superimposition with next overlay; mirror lake
shots.cut_in: hard cut (sudden calm after the spray)
shots.lighting_color: cool blue, pale mauve sky, rust mountain reflection
shots.dramatic_function: Calm wide that opens the first 'face over the lake' dissolve.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLUE, face centered and filling frame height, looking straight into lens, expressionless.
shots.action: Holds still; fades in (9.3-11.0, peak opacity ~60-70% at 11.0-12.5) and fades out (12.5-14.0) while the lake shots play beneath.
shots.vfx: slow cross-dissolve superimposition over shots 8 and 10 (generate the CU separately, composite in edit)
shots.dramatic_function: Puts BLUE's inner state over the landscape: the fight is also in his mind.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Low wide across the lake: pavilion on stilts at left third, pine slope behind, shimmering light patches on the water in the foreground right.
shots.action: Two figures (BLUE left, BLACK right) skim along the surface toward center, toes and swords drawing a long straight line of spray across the lake.
shots.cut_in: hard cut hidden under the face superimposition
shots.dramatic_function: Shows the duel on water while the face lingers.

shots.camera_move: handheld circling; ends in a fast whip pan right to blur
shots.subjects_and_blocking: Hillside: BLUE left facing right, BLACK right foreground often with back three-quarter to camera.
shots.action: Rapid exchange of 3-4 sword strokes; they circle; final 0.35 s is a whip pan to pure blur.
shots.cut_in: hard cut (sharp jump from calm to fight)
shots.dramatic_function: Second real-time clash; whip pan launches the aerial section.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Pavilion centered, seen from above; inside it a white bier is visible. The lake mirrors white sky and dark mountain shapes around it.
shots.action: Two small figures (light-blue and dark) and their reflections dart around the pavilion like swallows, crossing each other.
shots.lighting_color: dark mirror water, white sky reflections
shots.dramatic_function: Locates the bier at the center of the duel.

shots.angle: worm's-eye, straight up from just below the water surface
shots.subjects_and_blocking: White overcast sky fills the frame. BLACK glides horizontally over the camera, face-down, head at right, robe billowing toward the lens.
shots.action: He drifts across; his hand dips toward the lens and breaks the water surface between him and camera, raising a clear dome/crown of water at ~22.1 s.
shots.vfx: through-the-surface water layer (dome splash) in foreground
shots.lighting_color: bright white sky, dark navy silhouette
shots.dramatic_function: Impossible angle: we are inside the lake looking up.

shots.angle: worm's-eye, straight up through the water surface
shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLACK higher above, smaller in frame, one arm/leg hanging straight down toward the lens.
shots.action: His hand/foot touches the surface; a ring-shaped splash crater blooms in the foreground, bubbling and distorting him (23.3-24.0).
shots.dramatic_function: Second beat of the under-water view; water ripples into the next dissolve section.

shots.lens_feel: normal-tele, foreground leaves in focus, lake mid-ground slightly soft
shots.subjects_and_blocking: Bright red maple leaves and a dark trunk frame the top/left/right; through the gap, a misty lake. Two tiny dark figures fight in the air left of center.
shots.action: The two figures circle and clash in mid-air. From ~25.9 s BLACK's face begins to show through (overlay).
shots.lighting_color: saturated red leaves vs. cyan-blue lake (only strong red in the scene)
shots.dramatic_function: Second 'face over the lake' block, colour accent.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLACK, clean-shaven, long hair hanging loose at both sides of the face (dark vertical band at frame-left third), looking straight into lens.
shots.action: Fades in 25.9-27.5, peak ~27.5-28.6, slow fade-out 28.6-32.3 over the turquoise lake.
shots.dramatic_function: Mirror of BLUE's face block; BLACK's inner view.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Turquoise lake with frost-white bushes in foreground, pine/autumn slope and drifting mist behind; tiny pavilion center.
shots.action: Two tiny figures skim the water at right of the pavilion; the face overlay fades away; the landscape holds alone for ~2 s.
shots.cut_in: hard cut hidden under the overlay
shots.lighting_color: vivid turquoise water, lilac-grey frosted trees

shots.camera_move: handheld; opens on a whip-in blur past BLACK's shoulder
shots.subjects_and_blocking: Hillside: BLUE left facing right, BLACK right foreground back three-quarter.
shots.action: Whip-in from blur, then 3 quick blade exchanges, swords crossing overhead.
shots.dramatic_function: Short real-time jolt between two long stylised shots.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Symmetrical mountain valley; lake mirrors both slopes and clouds; pavilion small center-right on the water.
shots.action: Two tiny figures skim across the mirror surface left of the pavilion, leaving faint wakes.
shots.lighting_color: cool blue, cloud white, rust slopes
shots.dramatic_function: Scale: the duel is tiny inside nature.

shots.angle: low (looking up from below a ridge)
shots.lens_feel: wide, deep focus; figures pure silhouettes
shots.subjects_and_blocking: Bright, glowing misty sky fills 2/3; dark ridge/treeline across bottom third. Two silhouettes in the sky.
shots.action: Long aerial ballet: the two silhouettes glide in from the right, swoop, cross, face off and pass each other, small puffs of mist where they kick off.
shots.dramatic_function: Longest action shot; lyrical, weightless duel.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Pavilion with white-blossom tree at left; BLUE (left) and BLACK (right) hover just above the turquoise water to the right of it, swords raised, reflections under them.
shots.action: They drift right, trading strokes in the air; pavilion slides out frame-left.
shots.dramatic_function: Brings the duel back beside the bier.

shots.angle: high, looking down at the water (reflection image)
shots.subjects_and_blocking: Only the upside-down REFLECTIONS of the two duelists are seen on the water: BLUE left, BLACK right; pavilion corner at left edge at start.
shots.action: Inverted figures spin and thrust at each other; BLACK's sword jabs toward BLUE.
shots.vfx: reflection shot (can be made by vertical flip + ripple)

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Hillside: BLACK left lunging right with sword; BLUE right foreground spinning, sleeves blurring.
shots.action: BLACK thrusts; BLUE spins past; they end face to face.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: split-level waterline frame: lens half-submerged, upper ~40% above water, lower ~60% turquoise underwater. Blade vertical, center-left, tip underwater.
shots.action: Blade rises out of the water; drops spatter; surface settles.
shots.dramatic_function: Reprise of the opening motif (tele angle first this time).

shots.subjects_and_blocking: split-level waterline frame: lens half-submerged, upper ~40% above water, lower ~60% turquoise underwater. Wide angle with pavilion left; blade right of center, deep in water.
shots.action: Blade is drawn up and out; a tall column of water follows the tip and breaks into drops.
shots.dramatic_function: Loads water onto the blade for the drop volley.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Hillside slope fills frame. BLACK small at right mid-ground in guard stance; BLUE enters from lower left foreground.
shots.action: BLUE spins up into frame, wide sleeves flaring, flinging a spray of water drops from his blade; he leaps toward BLACK.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLUE center, facing left; droplets hanging in the air around him.
shots.action: He whips the sword in a horizontal arc left-to-right across his body, flinging droplets forward.

shots.camera_move: tracking with the drops (lateral), background streaking
shots.lens_feel: tele/macro, drops sharp, background fully blurred
shots.subjects_and_blocking: A short chain of 4-5 water drops in the center of frame.
shots.action: The drops fly through the air in slow motion, the camera matching their speed.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLACK center facing camera/left, sword horizontal at chest, mountain sky behind.
shots.action: He sweeps the blade left to deflect, then points two fingers (sword-finger gesture) forward, sending the drops back.

shots.camera_move: tracking with drops (reverse direction), sky then slope blurring past
shots.subjects_and_blocking: Chain of drops center frame.
shots.action: Drops fly back toward BLUE.

shots.lens_feel: normal -> tele, rack focus from face to blade
shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLUE centered, raising his blade diagonally across his face.
shots.action: Blade comes up as a shield; drops hit it and shatter into spray; focus slides off the blade onto one falling drop.

shots.camera_move: tilt down following the falling drop, then rack focus to the pavilion
shots.subjects_and_blocking: Single drop top-center against dark pines; as the camera tilts down, the misty lake and pavilion rise into frame left of center.
shots.action: One drop falls slowly; the tilt arrives on the pavilion where the bier is.
shots.cut_in: quick match-dissolve on the drop (~0.25 s, 64.48-64.73)
shots.dramatic_function: Bridge from duel to vigil: the drop travels to the dead woman.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Turquoise fabric (WOMAN's body he is holding) fills lower foreground; BLUE's head behind it.
shots.action: BLUE whips his head around (hair swinging) and looks up/right, eyes wide.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: WOMAN's face lying sideways, nose top-center, eyes closed.
shots.action: At ~68.0-68.3 a single drop lands on her cheek below the eye and rests there like a tear.
shots.dramatic_function: Key image: a tear she cannot cry.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Same set-up as shot 33.
shots.action: BLUE looks down at her, then lowers/turns his head away to the left; hair sweeps across the lens.
shots.dramatic_function: Pain; the hair wipe hands over to BLACK.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLACK right of center, sword held horizontal across the frame, blade toward left; misty mountain behind.
shots.action: He draws the blade back across himself and turns; camera whips off him into blur.
shots.cut_in: hard cut on the hair wipe

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Same lake + pavilion set-up as shot 8 (pavilion upper-left, inverted mountain reflection). Figures enter lower right.
shots.action: BLUE glides in from lower right, then BLACK from right; they meet over open water, toes touching the surface, making ripple rings; they clash and BLUE breaks toward the pavilion.
shots.dramatic_function: Long, calm wide: duel converges on the bier.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Pavilion deck: moss and logs with carved round ends upper half; WOMAN lies lower-left on a white bier under a pale turquoise cover.
shots.action: BLUE drops in from top-right, lands lightly on the deck beside her, sword in hand, and stands looking down at her.
shots.lighting_color: olive moss, blue robe, white bier
shots.dramatic_function: BLUE returns to the body: the vigil plane.

shots.angle: eye/high on the water then eye
shots.camera_move: tilt up from reflection to the real figure
shots.subjects_and_blocking: Opens on BLACK's upside-down reflection on mirror water; tilt reveals the real BLACK above it.
shots.action: He kicks off the water (ripple ring) and rises, knees tucked, sword out to the side, hovering above the lake.
shots.dramatic_function: BLACK rises for the final attack.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLUE centered, head bowed, looking down at WOMAN (out of frame below).
shots.action: Still; he looks at her.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: WOMAN's face, head tilted the other way from shot 34; drop on her cheek.
shots.action: Still; the drop glistens.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLUE left foreground looking down; BLACK in the right background hanging in the air above the shore, flying toward camera, arm outstretched, sword in hand.
shots.action: BLACK approaches through the air while BLUE does not look up.
shots.dramatic_function: Threat and stillness in one frame.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: First 0.35 s: blue sleeve fills the lens; it slides off to reveal WOMAN's face (same set-up as 41).
shots.action: BLUE's fingers enter from the left and touch her cheek to wipe the drop.
shots.cut_in: hard cut into a foreground fabric wipe

shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLACK's eyes and nose; an out-of-focus sword hilt/pommel points at the lens in lower-left foreground.
shots.action: He stares forward, intent.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: WOMAN's face; BLUE's two fingers press on her cheek.
shots.action: Fingers slowly wipe the drop away.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Same as shot 44.
shots.action: BLACK narrows his eyes and frowns; the hilt in foreground swings up and across as he strikes.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Sword tip enters from right pointing left; turquoise water surface blurred behind; a dark hair/robe edge wipes the left of frame at the start.
shots.action: The blade races low over the water.

shots.camera_move: pan right and tilt down following him
shots.subjects_and_blocking: Dark tree trunk left foreground; lake and mountain behind. BLACK flies in from left.
shots.action: Flying kick past the trunk; he somersaults upside-down in the air, sword pointing down, then dives head-first toward the lake (lower right).
shots.dramatic_function: BLACK commits: dives at the water.

shots.angle: frontal, slight low (he falls toward the lens)
shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLACK's face centered, hair streaming, wide-eyed; bright cyan background.
shots.action: He plunges toward camera, turns his head, brings his palm up in front of his face.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Water surface across lower frame; his palm and black sleeve enter from top.
shots.action: Open palm slaps flat onto the water; a sheet of spray erupts around the hand.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLACK in profile facing left, sword hilt raised at left, spray bursting across his face.
shots.action: He skims along the surface, water spraying over his face.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Palm and sleeve skimming the surface left-to-right.
shots.action: Hand drags over the water then lifts away, leaving a churned surface.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Reed/forest bank behind; BLACK horizontal in an explosion of white spray center frame.
shots.action: He bursts out of the water spinning horizontally, sword point up-right, and rises out of frame top-right.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLUE seated lower-center facing camera, eyes down (at WOMAN below frame). Behind him over the lake BLACK flies from center to upper right, sword extended.
shots.action: BLUE does not react while BLACK passes behind him in the air.

shots.camera_move: slow tilt/crane up from her face to his face
shots.subjects_and_blocking: Starts on BLUE's hand cupping WOMAN's cheek (her head right of center); tilt travels up his blue robe to his bowed face.
shots.action: He strokes her face; camera rises to his grieving face, eyes down.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Forested hillside (dark pines, one white-frosted tree left, orange larch). BLACK descends into frame from above, back to camera, lands center.
shots.action: He lands and stands still, back to us, sword at his side.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: WOMAN's face upright in frame, eyes closed; BLUE's hands at both sides of her face.
shots.action: His thumb gently strokes her brow.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLACK, wet face, long hair down on the left; turquoise lake and a pavilion pillar behind him.
shots.action: He looks into the lens, then lowers his gaze.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLACK's chin and collar; cyan background.
shots.action: Water gathers on his chin and drips, drop after drop.
shots.dramatic_function: Rhymes the 'tear' drop; lake water as his tears.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLUE centered, eyes down.
shots.action: Subtle shift of gaze; holds his grief.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLACK center, back to camera, sword in left hand; frost/snow-covered pine ridge and white mist ahead of him.
shots.action: He walks slowly away from camera, getting smaller.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: BLUE centered looking into lens.
shots.action: He brings clasped hands up to his mouth, closes his eyes and presses his face into his hands.

shots.subjects_and_blocking: Snow-frosted mountain ridge, mist; BLACK a small dark figure center-right, back to camera.
shots.action: He walks away into the white landscape (clip is cut by the end card at 131.67).
